seats.findings:
🟠 [bulk-threshold-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 uses `qty > 10`, so a line of exactly 10 units gets no bulk discount although the contract says 10 or more is 10 percent cheaper; change the comparison to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [coupon-divisor-wrong] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so every coupon discount is one tenth of the contracted Math.round(subtotal * pct / 100), which also corrupts checkoutTotal via src/checkout.js:7; change the divisor to 100

🟠 [bulk-discount-threshold] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5: the discount condition is `qty > 10`, but the contract grants the 10 percent discount when "qty is 10 or more", so a 10-item line is charged full price (e.g. 10 × 100¢ returns 1000 instead of Math.round(900) = 900); smallest remediation is changing the test to `qty >= 10 ? Math.round(gross * 0.9) : gross`.
🟠 [coupon-divisor-1000] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5: the discount divides by 1000 instead of 100, so every coupon is ten times too small (e.g. subtotal 10000, pct 10 → 100 instead of 1000), and checkout.js:6 inherits the error through couponCents, undercharging tax and total; smallest remediation is `Math.round((subtotal * p) / 100)`.
🟠 [invoice-format-concat] MUST-FIX src/invoice.js:5: the template interpolates the single sum `amount + taxCents(...)`, producing "label: 1080", but the contract specifies the string "label: amount+tax" with both values shown in integer cents (e.g. "label: 1000+80"); smallest remediation is `` `${label}: ${amount}+${taxCents(amount, rateBp)}` ``.

🟠 [bulk-threshold] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:4 uses `qty > 10` but the spec says "when qty is 10 or more the whole line is 10 percent cheaper"; qty === 10 incorrectly gets no discount; change to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 100; spec requires `Math.round(subtotal * pct / 100)` so a 10 % coupon on 5000 cents yields 50 instead of the correct 500; change `/1000` to `/100`
🔵 [coupon-affects-checkout] CUT/FOLLOW-UP the coupon divisor bug propagates into checkoutTotal via its call to couponCents; fixing coupon.js resolves both, so no separate fix is needed in checkout.js

🟠 [bulk-threshold-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 uses `qty > 10`, so a line of exactly 10 units gets no discount although the contract says "10 or more" is 10 percent cheaper; change the condition to `qty >= 10`
🔵 [invoice-format-ambiguity] CUT/FOLLOW-UP src/invoice.js:5 renders the summed value (e.g. "Widget: 108") while the spec text "label: amount+tax ... both in integer cents" could also be read as showing the two components literally; the summed reading is a defensible interpretation, so this is excluded pending spec clarification
🔵 [split-n-zero] CUT/FOLLOW-UP src/split.js:4 does not guard n <= 0 (division yields Infinity/NaN and an empty array); the contract does not define behaviour for n < 1, so excluded from this version

🟠 [bulk-threshold-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 the discount condition uses `qty > 10` but the contract says "when qty is 10 or more", so bulkCents(10, 100) returns 1000 instead of the required 900 (10% off applies at exactly qty 10); smallest remediation is changing the condition to `qty >= 10`

🟠 [bulk-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:4 — the spec states the 10% discount applies "when qty is 10 or more" (qty >= 10), but the code uses `qty > 10`, so qty === 10 incorrectly receives no discount. Change the condition to `qty >= 10`.
